_about: What spells leave on the ground of the fantasy world (rules: core/ground_rules.gd, play: game/ground_marks.gd). Placeholders for the director. max_marks: how many marks exist at once (the oldest goes first). max_height: a spell that bursts higher than this above the ground leaves nothing. spikes: a spell whose bits are one of `shapes` (data/fantasy/spells.json look.shape) and whose form is one of `forms` leaves its spikes standing for `seconds`; creatures on foot among them are slowed by `slow` and take damage_share of the spell's hit every `tick` seconds. fire: a spell that burns (and does not wet) leaves burning ground of radius_share x its own radius (not below min_radius, not above max_radius) for seconds + seconds_per_element for each element in the cast; creatures in it take damage_share of the hit every tick and keep burning burn_seconds. water: a spell that wets (and does not burn) leaves a puddle; more water in the same place adds its AREA to the puddle up to max_radius; from flood_radius on it is a flood that slows creatures by flood_slow; whoever stands in water stays wet for wet_seconds (wet creatures take half again as much from lightning, the old rule); a puddle dries after seconds + seconds_per_m for each metre of radius. Fire that lands in water goes out and boils part of the puddle away; water that lands on fire puts it out. shock: lightning (a spell that chains or shocks) touching a puddle hits EVERY creature standing in it for damage_share of the hit and stuns it `stun` seconds, at most once every `again` seconds per puddle. Flying creatures are above all of it; nothing here hurts players.
